title: How tiny is it?
prompt: Place each one by its characteristic diameter.

items.label: B-form DNA double helix
items.fact: B-form DNA has a helical diameter of 1.9 nanometres and about ten base pairs per turn.

items.label: Echovirus 30 particle
items.fact: Researchers observed round picornavirus particles about 30 nanometres across by electron microscopy.

items.label: Pandemic H1N1 virion
items.fact: Pandemic H1N1 virions were mostly spherical with an average diameter of 104 nanometres; some filaments reached 3.3 micrometres long.

items.label: E. coli bacterium
items.fact: The referenced E. coli cell is a cylinder about 2 micrometres long and 1 micrometre in diameter.

items.label: Human red blood cell
items.fact: Normal human red blood cells are biconcave disks with a mean diameter of about 7.5 micrometres.

items.label: Human egg cell
items.fact: A human egg is about 0.1 millimetre in diameter, several times wider than a typical somatic cell.
